segments.text: You launched a paid API for AI agents. It looks fine. But agents can't pay it, and nothing tells you why.
x402 Doctor checks your endpoint the way a paying agent would, without spending a cent.
In seconds you see every check: the 402 challenge, each payment option, the Solana payout account, discovery.
And for every problem, exactly what to change. Here, the price is written as dollars instead of token units, and the Solana option is missing its fee payer.
Fix it, and run it again.
That's for sellers. For buyers, there's something new.
Before your agent pays an unknown API, it asks the Doctor first, for a tenth of a cent.
Go, caution, or no-go. Plus the cheapest payment option that will actually settle.
And every day, we check every x402 endpoint in the Coinbase Bazaar. Over sixteen thousand.
Each one gets a thirty-day track record, so agents know who's reliable, and sellers can see their own score.
